mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over the prior three months signals a tightening monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) in periods where FEDFUNDS rises by >0.25% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 falls YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the unemployment rate above 6% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 6.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in industrial production (INDPRO below trend for three consecutive months) signals supply-side weakness, which raises input costs and lowers profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO is below trend for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL above their respective 12-month averages signals a monetary tightening accompanied by rising inflation, which increases real interest rates and erodes equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL exceed their 12-month averages.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in housing starts (HOUST) above its 6-month moving average, combined with a concurrent rise in personal savings (RSAFS), signals a shift toward future-oriented household investment, which boosts optimism and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 6-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above its trend for four consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days in any macro regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS is above trend for four consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A coordinated decline in both industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) below their 3-month moving averages signals broad-based supply contraction, which raises costs and reduces demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days except during periods of aggressive monetary easing.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO and HOUST are below their 3-month moving averages outside of monetary easing periods.
